subject: wholesale changes to matrix and agrad/matrix

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: wholesale changes to matrix and agrad/matrix
parts:
I'm cleaning up math/matrix and agrad/matrix and all
the tests. Please don't touch these files for the next
day or two as I work through them or we'll never be
able to merge -- I'm touching almost every function
in both files to either add error handling or eliminate
redundant defs/promotions in favor of templates.

As is, there are gazillions of redundant functions, many
with too-specific types. The general pattern was to promote
return types to var, then use .val() to pull out values.
I'm simplifying back to the basic types in the tests and
generalizing the template types to eliminate functions.

- Bob
